title: Liquid AI's d1-ultra Tops Decision Index with No Output Costs
summary:
The company's new multimodal AI can process images and text to select an answer without generating expensive output tokens. Liquid AI released d1-ultra on Oct. 15, which ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index with a score of 65, surpassing Jev 1.13 and Jev 1.14, which scored 58 and 57 respectively. Because it only pays for input at a rate of $0.042 per million tokens, the model is designed to lower costs for agents performing binary or multiple choice tasks.

The model supports 44 languages and leads all eight categories of Liquid AI's 112 evaluation suite with a calibration error of 1.5. Demos include operational use cases such as identifying broken product listings, picking Pokémon moves, and sorting trash from photos. This release follows the Jev series launch by less than one day, targeting a market for discrete decision-making rather than standard generative chat completions.

selectedTweets.text:
Liquid AI just shipped a model that doesn't write. It decides.

d1-ultra takes text and images, picks an answer, and that's it. No output tokens, so you only pay input: $0.042 per million.

> #1 on Artificial Analysis' Decision Index at 65
> Jev 1.13 at 58, Jev 1.14 at 57
> 44 languages, best calibration error in their 112-eval suite (1.5)

Demos are sorting trash from a photo, picking Pokémon moves and catching broken product listings. Boring jobs, which is exactly where this pays off.

Half the agent calls in production are a yes/no or pick-one dressed up as a chat completion. Someone finally priced that like what it is.
